abstract: In their latest Cell Genomics paper, "Characterization of subclonal variants in HG002 Genome in a Bottle reference material as a resource for benchmarking variant callers," Nathan Olson and colleagues provide the latest Genome in a Bottle (GIAB) benchmark resource, covering subclonal variants for the widely used HG002 reference material. In this Q&A, Dr. Olson discusses this latest research and the latest advances in the computational genomics field.
